name: Main Agent Loop Integration Test
description: Simulates the main agent loop, sending reflective user inputs and verifying agent responses and exit behavior.
input: Simulated user inputs: a valid message, then 'quit'. LLM client is mocked to return canned responses.
output: Agent prints expected responses and exits gracefully on 'quit'.
success_criteria: Agent prints the expected LLM response for the user message
Agent prints 'Goodbye!' and exits when 'quit' is entered
No unhandled exceptions occur during the loop
error_scenarios: Agent does not print expected responses
